name: Abyssal Edge reaches Blade of the Empire's crit chance and mana cost through the native spellmod system (#874)
contract: Abyssal Edge 582836 (Spell.dbc, read for this scenario) is a passive with two SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA effects, target caster: effect 0 is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 7 (SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE), BasePoints 1 DieSides 1 (+2), EffectSpellClassMask word 1 bit 20 (1048576); effect 1 is aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST), BasePoints -26 DieSides 1 (-25), same classmask word/bit. Blade of the Empire 502114 (a representative rank, read for this scenario) is SpellFamilyName 31 with SpellFamilyFlags word 1 = 1048576, an exact match. SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod's family-31 switch (SpellInfo.cpp) lists only 520682/520810/680600/802047/805115/681102/681389/806768 as needing special routing; 582836 is not among them, so it falls through to the generic IsAffected(family, classmask) check used by every class's percentage/flat spellmods -- no script is needed. grep confirms zero occurrences of 582836 in src/server/coa or src/server/game, matching the issue's own evidence that no per-spell script exists; none is needed here. spell_modifier calls player->ApplySpellMod directly, so the assertions exercise the exact runtime path (including IsAffectedBySpellMod), not just the DBC value.

steps.label: BASELINE: Blade of the Empire's crit chance modifier is untouched
BASELINE: Blade of the Empire's cost modifier is untouched
Learning the passive applies its own self-aura
Effect 0 carries the authored +2 crit chance flat modifier
Effect 1 carries the authored -25% cost modifier
CONTRACT: Blade of the Empire's crit chance modifier rises by +2 (SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE)
CONTRACT: Blade of the Empire's mana cost modifier is -25% (100 -> 75, SPELLMOD_COST)
Crit chance modifier returns to baseline
